description: Fortra GoAnywhere MFT GACMD REST API integration. Each declared GoAnywhere Project becomes a daily-partitioned Dagster asset with a retry policy, via a client abstraction (submit/poll) shared by demo and real mode so the same calling logic runs either way. Scaffold (rerun/dashboard/reconciliation ops+jobs, inbound-trigger sensor) is opt-in via generate_* flags, off by default. demo_mode=true (default) uses a demo client that logs a simulated GACMD lifecycle on stdout -- GoAnywhere's official Docker images need a trial or paid license key to do anything, so there's no zero-license way to hit a real server.

outputs.description: One daily-partitioned Dagster asset per GoAnywhere Project + optional source-file assets + opt-in ops/jobs/sensors/schedule.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Use the demo client (logs a simulated GACMD lifecycle, no external calls) instead of the real REST client.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: GoAnywhere MFT REST API base URL (used when demo_mode=false).

projects.label: Projects
projects.description: GoAnywhere Projects to wrap as daily-partitioned Dagster assets. Each item: {project_name, asset_name, description?, domain?, job_name?, job_queue?, mode?, priority?, variables?, deps?} -- deps is per-project, not shared.

source_files.label: Source Files
source_files.description: Files/folders landed by GoAnywhere that Dagster observes (adds to lineage). Each item: {path, asset_name, description?, group_name?, produced_by?}.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for the project assets.

goanywhere_user_env.label: GoAnywhere User Env Var
goanywhere_user_env.description: Env var holding the GoAnywhere REST username (or an admin API key).

goanywhere_password_env.label: GoAnywhere Password Env Var
goanywhere_password_env.description: Env var holding the GoAnywhere REST password (or the admin API key value).

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between GoAnywhere job status polls (real mode only -- demo mode doesn't sleep).

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Total seconds to wait for terminal state before failing.

partition_start_date.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start_date.description: Start date for the daily partitioned assets.

generate_external_monitor_sensor.label: Generate External Monitor Sensor
generate_external_monitor_sensor.description: Build the goanywhere_external_execution_monitor sensor. Cycles through every declared project, not just the first.

generate_inbound_trigger_sensor.label: Generate Inbound Trigger Sensor
generate_inbound_trigger_sensor.description: Build the goanywhere_inbound_trigger sensor. It only logs a simulated message in demo mode and does nothing in real mode until you wire a real webhook/event source -- off by default.

generate_rerun_job.label: Generate Rerun Job
generate_rerun_job.description: Build the goanywhere_rerun_project op-backed job. Off by default -- Dagster+'s own re-execution-from-failure covers most of this.

generate_dashboard_job.label: Generate Dashboard Job
generate_dashboard_job.description: Build the goanywhere_dashboard op-backed job (service status / active sessions / transfer summary).

generate_reconciliation.label: Generate Reconciliation
generate_reconciliation.description: Build the reconciliation op/job and its hourly schedule.

reconciliation_cron.label: Reconciliation Cron
reconciliation_cron.description: Cron for the GoAnywhere vs Dagster state reconciliation job (only used when generate_reconciliation=true).

translation.label: Translation
translation.description: Optional per-project customization hook applied to each project's AssetSpec. group_name/kinds/deps/description/owners are REPLACED; tags/metadata are MERGED onto the component's defaults (Dagster framework behavior).

name: GoAnywhereIntegration
